source_metadata: Cell Saga #191 retained; no World Games #173 data used

review.expression: User-selected narrow turquoise eyes, firm brows and closed neutral mouth retained exactly in source artwork; compared with the printed crossed-arm Goku reference.
review.line_cleanup: No regeneration, retouching, recoloring, sharpening or contour changes. Exact selected source bytes reused.
review.framing: Existing full-bleed illustration placement retained: x0, y0, width1060, height1484, xMidYMid meet. Large head/torso and resting hand remain left of stages. Top hair and lower forearms are cropped by the retained native bars, consistent with the preceding tight-crop draft.
review.line_review_result: No obvious doubled contours or broken outlines observed in the reviewed face and visible hand. Selected raster detail is retained; no claim of zero possible AI artifacts.
review.scope: Cell Saga Goku #191 only. All nine other native cards and display/download/PNG exports remain byte-identical to ZIP version 5. Not published.
review.palette: Selected warm peach skin, salmon shadows, gold/orange gi and indigo-blue clothing retained without color grading.
review.artwork_identity_note: This artwork belongs to Cell Saga #191, Goku, Earth's Hero. The supplied ZIP was mislabeled World Games #173; none of that card's game data or frame was imported.
